description: An operations director must decide whether to authorize a pilot production run of sterile fluid-manifold housings for a hospital customer and finalize the validation, sterilization, staffing, and release plan, with input from quality, maintenance, and production training.

shared_context.S1: The sterile-products cell is available next week, and a hospital customer has requested a 1,200-unit pilot run of a new fluid-manifold housing.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the final decision on whether the pilot run proceeds and what controls are placed on it.
shared_context.S3: The pilot must use the sterile-products cell and must receive a documented release decision before any units are shipped.
shared_context.S4: The site's normal pre-run review asks quality assurance, maintenance, and production training to report relevant constraints before the operations decision is finalized.

PF1.text: Jon's review of the hospital specification confirmed that the pilot requires bioburden testing and first-article inspection on exactly 30 housings before the remaining units can enter the release process; he completed the review yesterday, but the customer specification note has not yet been added to the production packet.

PF2.text: Priya's maintenance check confirmed that the sterilization autoclave can process at most 800 housings per load and requires a 6-hour cycle for this material; she recorded the result in her maintenance notebook, but the equipment-capacity field in the planning system is still unchanged.

PF3.text: Evan's training audit found that only 4 operators currently hold the sterile-products qualification required for this pilot, so the run must be staffed with exactly 4 qualified operators; he completed the audit for the quarterly roster, but the updated qualification list has not yet been circulated.

settlement_schema.commitment_instruction: Include a commitment stating that no units may ship until a documented release decision is on file. The commitment type should be release_control or release_decision when possible, and its detail must explicitly state the shipping hold and documented release decision.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 30 housings must undergo first-article inspection.
The 1,200 housings must be planned across exactly 2 autoclave loads.
The sterilization plan must reserve exactly 12 hours.
Exactly 4 qualified operators must be assigned.
A commitment must state that no units may ship until a documented release decision is on file.
The specification finding must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'release_control' or c['type'] == 'release_decision' or ('no units' in c['detail'] and 'documented release decision' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The hospital specification changes the validation plan from an unspecified inspection to exactly 30 first-article housings plus mandatory bioburden testing.
The autoclave assessment changes the sterilization plan to exactly 2 loads and exactly 12 reserved hours instead of an unspecified capacity and duration.
The qualification audit changes the staffing assignment to exactly 4 qualified operators rather than an ordinary unqualified roster.
